verdict.rationale: Basecamp's API repo has an explicit 'AI agents' section that points agents to first-party Basecamp Skills, which is a form of agent-oriented guidance, and it publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec. However, there is no evidence of an llms.txt file, and a probe for a markdown docs variant returned 404. missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt file, documented contents of the agent-oriented Skills docs, markdown-served docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The OpenAPI spec and this REST API reference cover authentication, pagination, and every endpoint in detail.
